ios.desc:
Download the New Yorker app for award-winning journalism on politics, culture, and the world. Get investigative reporting, cultural criticism, exclusive podcasts, and daily cartoons—plus access to decades of archives, all in one place.

POLITICS, CULTURE, AND INVESTIGATIVE REPORTING
- Stay informed with breaking news and in-depth analysis on stories that matter.
- Follow journalists and subjects you care about. Get notified when new coverage publishes.
- Browse Channels for focussed coverage of politics, culture, business, science, and books.
- Dive into award-winning investigative reporting that exposes truths about the world.

PERSONALIZED DIGESTS AND NEWSLETTERS
- Explore curated newsletters on politics, culture, fiction, cartoons, and more.
- Personalize your feed based on your reading interests and get recommendations tailored to you.

EXCLUSIVE PODCASTS AND AUDIO JOURNALISM
- Listen to exclusive audio narrations of New Yorker articles on your commute.
- Explore The New Yorker's premium podcast lineup, interviews, panel discussions, and investigative series.
- Seamlessly switch between audio and reading where you left off.

CARTOONS, ARCHIVES, AND VISUAL STORYTELLING
- Browse The New Yorker's legendary cartoons and visual journalism daily.
- Access decades of archives—explore the full depth of New Yorker reporting and criticism.
- Discover fiction, humor, and cultural coverage across all formats.

Download The New Yorker app today to discover the journalism that helps you understand not just what's happening, but why it matters. Deep reporting on politics, culture, and the world—always evolving, always essential.

The app is free to download. Subscribers receive unlimited access. App subscribers have full access to the website, including the archive and most recent issue. Users who have trouble accessing stories can contact Customer Care for assistance. 

Non-subscribers may access the app by starting a 7-day free trial which automatically renews for $11.99 per month or $119.99 annually, unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. The Apple account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period and will state the cost of renewal. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
